backstory:
Born in Dolestan to a family of 70, Dmitri Volvachev started life as a horrible amalgamation of human and D'ziriak. His mother, a D'ziriak, was kidnapped and forced for the rest of her natural born life to give birth to horrendous mixtures of human and bug life. His father, a shapeshifting human, was forced to breed with various races (Goblins, D'ziriak, Trolls, Orcs … ) in an attempt to push the limits and see if any combination is viable. Only a handful were not stillbirths, and even fewer made it into adolescence. Dmitri, a true struggler, fought and fought and fought to survive. He passed all kinds of tests and was deemed a successful experiment. However, he was a gross abomination, the proud Dolestani government could never allow for a creature such as himself to ruin Dolestan's reputation. But, he was too valuable of a resource to just dispatch of, instead they used his ever expanding intelligence to aid in their efforts towards this research. Dmitri, a child who was raised to survive and even thrive at this stage eagerly accepted this new position in the shadow government of Dolestan running vile experiments that corrupted his mind and his soul.
After reaching the age of 13, Dmitri was already assisting in these vile experiments. Typically, because he was quite dexterous, Dmitri played the role of a Surgeon creating various amalgamations composed of many different creatures all at once. In the beginning he was merely testing how much one creature could take and what was the most versatile base creature. Each experiment taught him a bit more about the limits of what different creatures could withstand. Sometime after this, Dmitri, in his own mind, rejected that he was at all related to these lesser creatures. How could some lowly creature even be considered on the same level as himself. After years of trial and error, Dmitri came upon a breakthrough, a method in which he could artificially create a magic bloodline in a durable human lineage. Due to this grand achievement and his fierce loyalty to research, he was granted his own research station by Dolestan's government.
Years after researching lesser creatures, Dmitri realized he had plateaued. His current human body could only achieve so much on its own. His research already revealed astounding results, but he wasn't satisfied. He had to change something. He eventually began utilizing the knowledge he developed over (now) decades of research on pushing his mind past the human limit. Of course through this process he finally severed his physical connection to humanity. Of course, Dmitri would refer to himself as the next stage in evolution for humanity, but most would call him an abomination. Something so heinous it shouldn’t exist. He created a simulacrum of himself to perform surgery on his brain, combining certain parts with that of a dragon + Illithid. After that, he used alchemical mixtures to increase the surface area of his 10x.His mind was now altered permanently, it could process information many times faster than a human with sage tier intellect. He could read novels in mere minutes. He could pick up a language after a few hours with a native speaker. 
But, it came at a cost. His body would constantly eat away at itself, the processing power of his brain now makes him require at least 25,000 calories a day [which he ingests through extremely dense nutrient pastes so as to not waste time eating]. He also removed the portion of his brain which allows him to feel any sort of emotion at all, deeming it as unnecessary. Unfortunately, his body immediately began naturally rejecting this, so he started pumping himself full of a mixture of immunosuppressants + copious amounts of drugs + medicines +vitamins. However, this wasn’t good enough, his body was definitely dying and only had weeks left. So, he paid millions of gold (earned from Dolestan) to some of Dolestan’s strongest patriots to gather a living phoenix and hold it down long enough for him to transfer over its internal organs to himself. It worked, somewhat, however every moment Dmitri lives he is in excruciating pain, barely even nullified by the copious painkillers he automatically injects into his body daily. Also, he now has the wonderful side effect of random organ failure. However, Dmitiri dies, on average, once a week and is brought back to life by his Phoenix organs he implanted into himself. 
Now that his mind was as physically and alchemically enhanced as possible, Dmitri moved onto something a bit less scientific. Dealing with a Devil for Profane knowledge and a potential fix for the indescribable agony he constantly suffers through. To do this, Dmitri studied many libraries worth of knowledge to gain information on a single mid ranking Devil learning everything he could about it. His name, domain, hobbies, dislikes, family, origin, age, … After doing this, alone because he was that confident, Dmitri bound the Devil to a spell/science circle he handcrafted himself and forced it to sign a rather favorable contract. Dmitri’s would permanently stop aging, stop suffering random organ failure, his pain would be nullified completely. Also, he would be granted a bit of profane knowledge. In return, Dmitri offers 1666 souls monthly to this Devil.
